name: feature.forms.nodes
description: Forms feature node pack — read nodes over the ctx.features.forms surface shipped by the Forms feature package. list-forms reads an org's forms; list-submissions reads a form's captured submissions; get-submission reads one submission's values + intake binding (the forms→priority-matrix bridge).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Forms: List Forms
nodes.description: Lists an org's forms over ctx.features.forms. Tenant-guarded.

nodes.label: Forms: List Submissions
nodes.description: Lists a form's captured submissions over ctx.features.forms. Tenant+org-guarded.

nodes.label: Forms: Get Submission
nodes.description: Reads one submission's values + the form's intake binding over ctx.features.forms. Tenant+org+form-guarded. The forms→priority-matrix bridge (ADR 0247). ADR 0584: emits `flagged` and answers `willFile:'no'` for a QUARANTINED submission, so a held row is never filed as intake.
